newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS shares rise after 9-mth report.
newsitem.headline: UBS shares rise after 9-mth report.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland's (UBS) bearer share price rose four Swiss francs to 1,238 in early trading after the bank reported that cash flow and group profit for the first nine months of 1996 were above the comparable figures for the same period of 1995.
Analysts said the results were mostly in line with expectations, but the continued high level of provisions was disappointing.
UBS also said it was cautiously optimistic about the year as a whole, but that provisions remained higher than expected.

The UBS share price gain was generally in line with the market. The blue chip SMI index opened 6.9 points, or 0.18 percent higher at 3,765.8 and the broad SMI index bagan 2.38 points higher at 2,415.57.
